quote: You feel that sudden pit in your stomach? That is Sunday. It is when your brain starts listing every single email you ignored. Your weekend fun suddenly feels like a distant, blurry memory. You are physically on your couch but mentally drafting your resignation letter. We spend all week waiting for Friday just to dread the next Monday.
